case.title: Photocatalytic aerobic oxidation of Fmoc-L-methionine
case.protocol: Fmoc-L-methionine (3.7 mmol, 1.0 equiv) and 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole (10 mol%) were dissolved in acetonitrile at 0.10 M in a round-bottom flask. The solution was exposed to air and irradiated with a 1.5 W LED centered near 420 nm at 21 C for 5 min. Fmoc-methionine sulfoxide was formed in 99% yield.

analogies.summary: This Csp2-Csp3 cross-coupling reaction employs photoredox/nickel dual catalysis using Ir(dFCF3ppy)2(bpy)PF6 as the photocatalyst at 2.5 mol% loading with 2,6-lutidine base in THF solvent. The reaction operates at 30°C with blue LED irradiation at 450 nm in a Vapourtec E-series UV-150 flow reactor (10 mL volume) with a 40-minute residence time at 0.25 mL/min flow rate. Flow processing achieved a remarkable 36-fold intensification, reducing reaction time from 24 hours in batch to just 40 minutes while simultaneously improving yield from 60% to 71%. The dramatic improvement stems from the superior light penetration and photon efficiency of the blue LED system compared to the CFL light source used in batch, combined with the optimized irradiation geometry in the dedicated flow photoreactor.
